theme_archetype.description: Dark-first, tactical command-center HUD. Designed for high-stakes criminal strategy. Minimalist chrome, high data density, vivid kinetic triggers over an OLED black/dark grey base.

data_metrics.usage: Use for all resource counts, timers, distances, and levels to give a hacker/software feel

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Map is Hero. All UI elements float above the map.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Dense and tactical. Use p-2, p-4. Avoid excessive empty space in data cards.
layout_and_spacing.mobile_first: Use bottom drawers (Sheet component from Shadcn) for main menus and team lists on mobile. Floating compact cards on desktop.

panels.classes: bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-lg shadow-2xl

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-200 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-sm
buttons.danger_dispatch: bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(220,38,38,0.4)] transition-all duration-300

components.auth_screen: Fullscreen cinematic background image with a centered dark glass panel. Dramatic lighting.
components.resource_bar: Top floating pill or bar. JetBrains Mono for numbers. Distinct colors for clean/dirty money.
components.opportunity_card: Compact bento-style card. Clear risk/reward metrics. Urgent dispatch button.
components.teams_panel: Side or bottom drawer. Status indicators (Idle=Gray, En-Route=Cyan, Operating=Red).
components.activity_feed: Scrolling terminal-like log. Small text, high density.

motion_and_interactions.panel_entrance: Framer motion slide-in from edges (y: 20, opacity: 0).
motion_and_interactions.map_markers: Smooth CSS transitions for vehicle movement.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hover states must lift cards slightly (-translate-y-1) and increase border opacity to white/30.

icons.style: weight='bold' or weight='duotone' for tactical feel

auth_background.description: Aerial view of Lisbon at night, used for Login/Register background

texture_overlay.description: Dark grime texture, use with low opacity (mix-blend-overlay) over flat dark panels if needed

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_requirement: ALL interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='dispatch-team-button', data-testid='login-submit')
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure pure white text over the dark map or glass panels passes WCAG AA.
